In `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`, `askDM` calls `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` (json_object format); on throw it retries `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`; if that also throws, it returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)` directly.

Otherwise, raw text goes to `parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`, which strips code fences/extracts the first `{…}` block, then `JSON.parse`s it. If input is empty/non-string, no `{…}` found, or `JSON.parse` throws, it also returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.

`fallbackNarrative` returns a canned `AIDMResponse`: a generic narrative string, all `gameStateChanges` fields null/false/empty, 4 default `suggestedActions`, and empty `diceRolls` — so the game never crashes on bad AI output.
